summary: Augment class constructor object with namespace exports.

source.pattern: class C {} namespace C { export const x=1 }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: class property
tests.input: class C {}; namespace C { export const x=1 }; console.log(C.x,new C() instanceof C);

tests.name: enumerable
tests.input: class C {}; namespace C { export const x=1 }; console.log(Object.keys(C).includes('x'));
